==Skin Trivia==
*The '''Accelerator''' formerly used the [[War Machine]] upgrade icons, which is a tower only a few selected people have.
**As of the [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], the '''Accelerator''' no longer uses the ''War Machine'' icons, and now uses its own icons.
***The '''Accelerator's''' Level 5 upgrade icon has the [[Enemies Beta]] versions of the [[Speedy Boss]] and [[Slow Boss]] in it.
*The Level 5 '''Accelerator''' changes the color of some effects to a different color.
**Because of a bug, this does not normally occur. It can only occur when you upgrade the '''Accelerator''' to Level 5 when the effect particles are still active.
**The tower ability particles, such as the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'', will change colors.
***During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], this also happened with the [[Militant|John]]'s ''Enraging Shout'' ability.
**Stun particles, such as basic stun particles also change color.
**Before 7th of April 2023, the tower indicator ring under the '''Accelerator''' also changed colors.
**The color of some effects is changed depending on the skin.
***The Default, {{Color|Other|Plushie}}, {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}}, {{Color|Deluxe|Deluxe}}, {{Color|ContentCreator|Dank}}, {{Color|Other|Patient Zero}} and {{Color|Hexscape|Disco}} skins changes it to purple.
***The {{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} and {{Color|Basic|Navy}} skins change it to white.
***The {{Color|Lovely|Cupid}}, {{Color|Halloween|Ghost Buster}} and {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} skins change it to red, though it is a different shade of red for each skin.
***The {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} and {{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} skins changes it to orange.
***The {{Color|ColdFront|Ice Witch}} skin changes it to blue.
***The {{Color|Basic|Red}} and {{Color|Krampus|Legend}} skins change it to light yellow.
***The {{Color|Mission|Nuclear}} skin changes it to sea green.
***The {{Color|ContentCreator|Elite}} skin removes them completely.
*The {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} skin was most likely removed due to bugs.
**The appearance did not change when upgraded and the animations were broken.
**For some reason, the unboxed version of the {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} and the {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} in the skin preview are different from the one seen in-game.
*Prior to the [[Duck Hunt Event]], the {{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} skin used the same face as some hidden enemies, such as the [[Shadow]] and [[Hidden Boss]].
**It also has dark green skin, similar to a lot of enemies in the game.
*The prism used by the {{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} skin and by the first and second versions of the {{Color|ColdFront|Ice Witch}} skin  is a reference to the [https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Last_Prism Last Prism] from ''Terraria''.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} skin was originally going to use a staff, which would change with Levels, but in the game it does not.
*The '''Accelerator’s''' icon used during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] is the [[w:c:kirby:Kirby Super Star Ultra|Kirby Super Star Ultra]] sprite for ''Kirby’s'' [[w:c:kirby:Beam|Beam]] copy ability.
*The {{Color|Halloween|Ghost Buster}} skin is a reference to ''Ghostbusters''.
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Elite}} skin is based on the content creator [https://www.youtube.com/@EliteElite Elite].
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Elite}} skin is the only tower skin to still use the [[w:c:Roblox:Normal face|Roblox default face]].
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} skin is based on upgraded version of [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:Titan Speakerman#Upgraded Titan Speakerman (2.0)|Titan Speakerman]].
**Weirdly, the first and the second version of {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} icon used the first version of {{Color|Premium|Deep Freeze}} [[Freezer]]'s icon.
*The {{Color|Mission|Nuclear}} skin was originally made by [https://twitter.com/SoupedGun SoupedGun], though the final model was also made with collaboration of Jaaziar.
**Originally, it was planned to have the laser come out of the skin's chest, but that got scrapped and replaced with a regular gun.
**Level 5 was at one point supposed to turn its neon parts yellow, before that was changed to a more teal, sea green.
*The {{Color|Mission|Nuclear}} skin is an updated version of the {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} skin.
*The {{Color|StarWars|Senator}} skin is based on [[w:c:starwars:Darth Sidious|Supreme Chancellor/Emperor Palpatine]] from ''Star Wars''.
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Dank}} skin is based on [https://www.youtube.com/@DanksPlatter DanksPlatter].
**This skin was made as a reward for being one of the first people to triumph [[Infernal Abyss]] on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, alongside [https://www.youtube.com/@CrazRex CrazRex] and [https://www.youtube.com/@5ouIs 5ouls]. All of them received a skin.
**The skin was made by [https://www.youtube.com/@5ouIs 5ouls], one of the people who he triumphed [[Infernal Abyss]] on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] with.
*The {{Color|Other|Patient Zero}} skin is based on the [[Patient Zero]] enemy.
**Some parts of its appearance, most notably the accessories gained at Level 2, are taken from the [[Living Experiment]].
*The {{Color|Surf|Octopus}} skin is a submission from the [https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1D68qT3NUsa896BUM-KBc4FhRZp6NFVK6HXmaR7alHEg Aquatic Fantasy] skin set made by 4it3dm1 and InkEve.
**The skin originally was a human wearing an octopus costume up until Level 5 which resembles an octopus more. It was changed into an anthropomorphic octopus when it was added into the game.
**Some minor design changes were made, such as the eyepatch gotten at Level 1 being removed.
*According to the [[Accelerator Octopus Charm]], the {{Color|Surf|Octopus}} skin is a rare subspecies of '''Accelerator''' rarely seen on the surface.
**The description suggests that the '''Accelerator''' is somehow different enough from humans to be considered its own species. This is most likely just a mistake, and it is meant to state it is a rare subspecies of octopus instead.
*The {{Color|Showtime|Magician}} skin's appearance is based on [[w:c:die-of-death:Artful|Artful]], a killer from the game ''Die of Death'' and from [https://deadlock.wiki/Sinclair Sinclair], a character from an upcoming game developed by Valve called ''Deadlock''.
**This skin is a submission made by [https://x.com/raincoatedd enbycoated].
*The {{Color|Beach|Beach}} skin was models were made by c4n<ref>https://x.com/canned4never/status/2073079616210706688</ref> while the concept art was made by UnknownCanvas.<ref>https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/608819410383405056/1523633050993295373 (Tower Defense Simulator Server)</ref>
*The burger pool floaty the {{Color|Beach|Beach}} skin wears is a reference to how '''Accelerator''' likes to eat hamburgers only on Monday and Friday.
